section.sectionSummaryBrief: Although the two interpretations of "Lech Lecha" are opposite, the single word proves it includes both a descent and ascent, paralleling "Vehithalachti" and "Komemiyut."
section.t: And behold, although the two above explanations of "Lech Lecha" are two different and opposite explanations,
since both explanations are in the same word
[and the instruction to every Jew in this portion]
a movement from above to below and a movement from below to above.
And analogous to "And I will walk among you"
the two aspects of movement mentioned above.
And so too regarding the matter of "And I will lead you erect,"
[the level of direct light and the level of reflected light,
which are analogous to the two aspects of movement mentioned above],
the intention in this is that "Komemiyut" includes both levels together.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This year, a leap year completing a small cycle, unites sun and moon, representing the two movements of bestower and receiver, making them one.
section.t: And one can connect this with this year
and moreover it is the leap year of the completion of a small cycle,
in which the alignment of the solar year with the lunar year is made
For the sun is an aspect of bestower – analogous to the concept of movement from above to below,
is an aspect of receiver – analogous to the concept of movement from below to above.
And the concept of the leap year
(and particularly the leap year of the completion of a small cycle)
is the combination and connection of the two services
and the service of the moon
"And our eyes will shine like the sun and the moon,"
[not only that there will be the two virtues,
the virtue of the sun and the virtue of the moon, but also]

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The unification of these two services prepares a vessel for drawing down the Ein Sof, which transcends above and below, culminating in the revelation of Atzmus.
section.t: [the combination and unification of the two above matters]
[and in a manner of a limb,
which is not only a receiver but also draws down]
for the drawing down of the Ein Sof, which is beyond the category of "above and below."
that after the completeness of arousal from below
and the revelation of arousal from above
afterward an arousal from above is drawn from a place that arousal from below does not reach there at all].
For the completeness of the service
[in the combination of the two above matters,
which is a vessel for the indwelling of the Ein Sof,
for the Holy One, blessed be He, dwells in a complete site.
And until that through this is made the drawing down of the Awtsmoos, which is the true and ultimate completeness.
And Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He,
and in a manner that it is not possible to distinguish between them,
since the Torah of truth testifies that they are one.
